scope: bounded regional public-source non-operational technical preview

channels.name: public issue tracker
channels.purpose: reproducible defects, documentation corrections and bounded feature requests
channels.intake: issue template with revision, command, expected result and observed result

channels.name: security disclosure
channels.purpose: security-sensitive reports that should not be posted publicly

channels.name: release and correction record
channels.purpose: versioned decisions, limitations, corrections and evidence links

triage.action: disable affected preview path and preserve evidence
fail closed, reproduce on exact revision and record scope
schedule bounded correction or documentation update

ownership.release_authority: named accountable authority decision required per tier
ownership.agent_panels: advisory analysis only; never factual participant evidence

sustainability_bounds: best-effort preview support; no guaranteed response time
support is limited to Python 3.14 and documented bounded workflows
network, timetable, facility, national, clinical, dispatch and authoritative claims remain disabled
unsupported or expired preview paths may be withdrawn with a correction record
nonclaims: This contract does not establish stable-v1 support, an SLA, external-user evidence or release approval.
The listed routes describe repository-owned intake and records; they do not prove an external support operation.
